problem_statement: Add an optional module named `sched_round_robin` that enables round-robin scheduling among runnable threads of the same scheduler priority. When the module is enabled, a thread that busy-waits without yielding must not permanently starve other threads at its priority. In a program that creates two threads at the same priority, one busy-looping and one waking a sleeping main thread, main must eventually be woken and the program must print [SUCCESS]. Enabling the module alone should make this behavior active in a normal RIOT application.
